B. Is this measure already running in South Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county (or in the Tays university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure reduce deaths among the people it reaches, and by how much?
Measure: Smoking cessation started at the first specialist visit. Every current smoker with suspected lung cancer gets cessation medication and counselling at the first visit, as part of preparing for curative treatment.
effect_summary_en: A 2021 Moscow cohort of 517 early-stage (IA-IIIA) NSCLC smokers found that quitting after diagnosis was linked to lower all-cause mortality (adjusted HR 0.67, 95% CI 0.53–0.85).
supported_en: Annals of Internal Medicine 2021: HR 0.67 (0.53–0.85) for all-cause mortality among early-stage NSCLC patients who quit after diagnosis compared with those who kept smoking.
not_supported_en: The study is observational and does not test a first-visit programme, so it does not show how many extra patients such a programme would get to quit.
in_use_quote: Tarkennetut mallit käytössä: tupakoimatomana leikkaukseen- ja lasta odottavan perheen toimintamallit.
in_use_summary_en: Since 15.2.2023 the county has had a cessation model for all of its care: the doctor diagnoses nicotine dependence and prescribes cessation medication, a nurse gives counselling, and a 'tupakoimattomana leikkaukseen' (smoke-free surgery) model is in use; Tays's lung cancer pathway records smoking at the specialist visit.
missing_en: No page shows a standing order that gives every smoker with suspected lung cancer medication and counselling at the first lung clinic visit.
summary_en: Since February 2023, Hyvaep's cessation model has told doctors to prescribe cessation medication and nurses to give counselling, and it has a smoke-free-surgery model in use; Tays's lung cancer pathway only says smoking is asked about at the specialist visit. No page shows a first-visit standing order for smokers with suspected lung cancer. A 2021 Annals of Internal Medicine cohort found quitting after diagnosis linked to an adjusted mortality HR of 0.67 (0.53–0.85) in early-stage NSCLC, which matches the size the model assumes.
unanswered_en: I found no Hyvaep or Tays lung clinic page saying that cessation treatment is started for every smoker at the first visit.
